subject: Opening Data Viewer Window from Console?

messages.author: 8c347bb6aaff118a
messages.subject: Opening Data Viewer Window from Console?
parts:
Hi Folks,

Sometimes the Data Viewer Window doesn't open or is accidentally closed. 

Is there some way for me to reopen it from within the Console?

Thanks,
Roger

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Opening Data Viewer Window from Console?
parts:
With menus: Packages & Data --> Data Viewer

or type data.viewer() into the console.

ian

messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: Re: Opening Data Viewer Window from Console?
parts:
This screenshot shows what your JGR menu looks like after loading deducer (Mac 10.8.4), as described by Ian.
Next time you start JGR you can make it load deducer or any other package automatically by ticking default in package manager or setting the JGR preferences "Deducer" to your liking.
While the data.viewer() command works, I have never seen any real need for using this on the Mac.

Best
Rudolf
